data.body:
[P2] Detect FLAT history behind missing STARTED containers

For a recorded STARTED branch, NESTED replay permits a missing container because the worker may never have run. However, FLAT branches also lack containers; if one previously wrote or suspended on inner operations, changing to NESTED reaches this validation with a missing checkpoint and silently returns STARTED without validating those operations' changed parents. When the NESTED container is absent, inspect direct batch children for evidence of prior FLAT execution and reject it, while still allowing truly unstarted branches. Add a FLAT-to-NESTED STARTED ReplayChildren test.
